min.description: The minimum value of the slider. Defaults to 0. Together with `max`, it defines the inclusive selectable range; `min` should be less than `max`.

max.description: The maximum value of the slider. Required. Together with `min`, it defines the inclusive selectable range; `max` should be greater than `min`.

value.description: The current value of the slider. It should be within the inclusive range defined by `min` and `max`; renderers may clamp out-of-range values.
